Table 'inventory': Data regarding the **current inventory or what is at hand** for each SKU in each store. Table 'dashboard_metrics': Stores **aggregated, high-level performance indicators (KPIs)**. All values are accumulated totals across the network. COLUMNS: id, timestamp, **inventory_position** (total SKU count in all stores), **weeks_of_supply** (accumulated WOS), **projected_stockouts**, **fill_rate_probability**.
